_comment: Where each sensor goes. `anchor` is a point derived from the vehicle's own bounding box when it is
mounted -- origin, roof_center, front_top (front of the box, roof height), front_bumper or
rear_bumper -- so one rig fits a coupe and a van.
`offset_m` is added to it, and `rpy_deg` orients the sensor, both in the vehicle's frame:
x forward, y left, z up, meters, right-handed (Tempo's API frame). `name` is the component name,
which is also the sensor name clients stream by.
